title: Fixed Concave Dish and Convex Shoe Support
description: One wholly newly authored complete fixed concave-dish and convex-shoe architectural support display. A broad grounded square plate has four real bounded mounting openings. A thick shallow dish seated on it has a genuinely spherical concave inner floor and full raised perimeter rim. An independent whole lower-convex shoe rests centrally on that sampled seat and rises through its integral short neck into a separate smaller upper plate with four true mounting apertures. The annular portion of the bowl and the space under the upper plate stay visibly open. Unlike the old bored spherical rod end there is no enclosing eye, transverse through-ball or long stem; unlike the open ball bearing there are no concentric races, rolling-ball row or cage. All visible geometry new, no old mesh or bearing component extracted or transformed. Four editable closed meshes, three opaque constant PBR roles, metre-style Z up with horizontal full-envelope centre on the lower plate sole, one model zero scenes. Fixed illustrative connector exterior only: coincident sampled contact is an artistic fixed seat, not a solved fit or an engineered friction-pendulum isolator. No sliding, articulation, self-centering, friction, seismic isolation, displacement, load transfer, fastening, structural rating, manufacture, installation or building safety capability. No host building, anchors, rigging, animation or interaction.
